_comment: Which spoken phrase each visual lands on. `cue` is a cue id from the section's page: a slide id,
then a short word. `on` is a word or short phrase from that section of script.md, matched ignoring
case and punctuation. `occurrence` picks which match, counting from 1. `$start` is the section start
and `$end` is the end of speech, and `offset` shifts a cue in seconds.
`decktalk align` reports any phrase it cannot find.
